about: Black Marsh's own materials: what each thing of gear is made of, in our terms, not the Skyrim keyword its record happens to carry (docs/design/items.md; issue #89). One row per material: its lore basis and statement tier; its ladder tier (one per material: every item of it takes Skyrim's stats for that tier and its weapon type or armour slot, written as overrides by the world build); its power class (the Skyrim material keyword of its tier, which smithing perks and tempering read); its band (how often it is met: common, uncommon, rare, situational, ruin, unique, never); its group in the target mix (organic, plate, metal, foreign); the Skyrim keywords that read as it when an item has no item_material row; who makes it (material_maker) and the conditions under which a place may hold it (material_reach: any one is enough). Frequency is never a chance (decision 0035): it is the tier ceiling, the reach condition and the fixed counts of the stock rows. Read by tools/newworld/stockdb.py (tables material, material_maker, material_reach, never_material) and tools/places/stock (split, reach).

bands.common: most holders, any wealth: every Black Marsh place
bands.uncommon: a smith's or hunter's trade: places that make or trade its good, a city's guard issue
bands.rare: one or two per place, behind a lock: the tier ceiling keeps it to the richer places
bands.situational: only where the place's record gives the reason (material_reach): a culture, a place kind, its words
bands.ruin: only in a ruin of its layer (material_reach), at the reward band's tier
bands.unique: only by story, in the world ledger (unique.json)

groups.organic: wood, bone, flint, hide and leather: the marsh's common make
groups.plate: the marsh's fine make: scale, shell, chitin, obsidian, bronze and the old relics
groups.metal: bog iron and copper-edged steel, worked by few smiths
groups.foreign: what other peoples made and carried in, or left in ruins

materials.label: Wood and bamboo
materials.lore: tamarack wood and bamboo: clubs, staves, bows and spear shafts (story/lore/topics/material-culture.md:55-57)

makers.why: every Argonian household cuts and shapes its own wood
the Naga's macana and bows are wood

materials.label: Bone and horn
materials.lore: bone and horn worked with bronze tools; Naga-Kur weapons of their own dead; Xit-Xaht bone plate (material-culture.md:59-77)

makers.why: Naga-Kur weapons are their own dead's bone

materials.label: Flint and jadeflint
materials.lore: jadeflint and obverdian edges set in wood (material-culture.md:55-56)

makers.why: the Naga's macahuitl are flint-edged wood

materials.label: Hide and fibre
materials.lore: raw hide, lizard-skin wraps and woven grass and fibre (material-culture.md:69-70)

makers.why: every household dresses hide and weaves fibre

materials.label: Marsh leather
materials.lore: wamasu hide hardened or made flexible, crocodile and hackwing leather (material-culture.md:57-58; ecology-encounters-loot.md:121-124); Skyrim's own leather shared as it is

materials.label: Argonian scale
materials.lore: giant-snake hide as Shadowfen armour and scale sewn on leather (ecology-encounters-loot.md:124); BM&V's Argonian guard armour and the Naga elite's scale

makers.why: the tanners and armourers of the towns

reach.why: the marsh's own make; the tier ceiling keeps it to the towns

materials.label: Turtle shell
materials.lore: turtle and haj mota shell for shield bosses and whole shields; the Shellbacks' armour (ecology-encounters-loot.md:125)

makers.why: shell-workers of the coasts and rivers

materials.label: Chitin
materials.lore: chitin is an attested Argonian working material (material-culture.md:59) and Morrowind's make; traded both ways over the border

materials.label: Bog iron
materials.lore: bog iron and steel with a rough copper alloy edge, worked by few smiths after the Duskfall (material-culture.md:52-57); Skyrim's iron and steel read as it

makers.why: a place with a bog-iron smith

reach.why: uncommon, never the default: the lead's call 1 (issue #89)

materials.label: Saxhleel bone-and-leather work
materials.lore: the Saxhleel's own bone blades and hardened wamasu leather (material-culture.md:56-58; King of the Murkmire's Saxhleel set): a finer make than raw bone and hide

materials.label: Copper-edged steel
materials.lore: steel with a rough copper alloy edge (material-culture.md:56-57): the Saxhleel metal set and BM&V's Argonian sword

makers.why: the few smiths who edge steel with copper

reach.why: uncommon; its tier keeps it to the towns

materials.label: Masu plate
materials.lore: plate over hardened wamasu hide (material-culture.md:57): the Reel-ka and Masu plate cuirasses, the heaviest Argonian make

reach.why: rare: its tier keeps it to a capital's treasury

materials.label: Volcanic glass
materials.lore: pre-Duskfall smiths' volcanic glass, the blade set in bronze (material-culture.md:52-54); HTBM's Xanmeer weapons and Cuauhtli armour

makers.why: the few who still knap and set volcanic glass

reach.why: rare: its tiers (T4 and up) keep it to a city's locked stores

materials.label: Pre-Duskfall bronze
materials.lore: pre-Duskfall bronze war gear and emblems (material-culture.md:52-54); Ancient Argonian Armor

makers.why: old gear kept and handed down

reach.why: rare: its tier keeps it to the rich and the old

materials.label: Xanmeer relic
materials.lore: the pre-Duskfall Argonian ruin layer: volcanic glass, bronze, gold (ecology-encounters-loot.md:145-150); HTBM's Xanmeer and Ocelotl sets

reach.why: a xanmeer or the record names its layer
a drowned spire of the old layer

materials.label: Kothringi relic
materials.lore: the Kothringi died of the Knahaten Flu in 2E 560; their scimitars, cleavers and shields lie in their towns

reach.why: the Chime-Keepers live in the Kothringi towns

materials.label: Shadowscale make
materials.lore: the Shadowscales' own armour and blades (story/design/quests/reward-gear.md)

materials.label: Imperial issue
materials.lore: the Imperial layer is penal, fiscal and military only, a civic legacy at Gideon alone (ecology-encounters-loot.md:154)

reach.why: the Warden Marches' forts are Imperial foundations
the record names an Imperial presence

materials.label: Bonemold
materials.lore: Dunmer make only: holdouts, slavers' leftovers, the Dunmer minority (argonia-4e201-state.md:430); the lead's call 2 (issue #89)

materials.label: Ayleid elven
materials.lore: the Barsaebic Ayleid layer (ecology-encounters-loot.md:151)

materials.label: Skyrim glass
materials.lore: malachite glass is no Black Marsh make (material-culture.md:52-60): only a ruin's hoard holds it

materials.label: Ebony
materials.lore: ebony is no Black Marsh make (material-culture.md:52-60): only a ruin's hoard holds it

materials.label: Daedric
materials.lore: Daedric gear enters only by story

reach.why: a row of the world ledger (unique.json)

materials.label: Dragon bone and scale
materials.lore: dragon gear enters only by story

reach.why: a row of the world ledger (unique.json)

materials.label: Dwarven
materials.lore: no Dwemer canon in the marsh: Dwarven gear has no road into Black Marsh (issue #89)

materials.label: Orcish
materials.lore: no Orsimer in Black Marsh in 4E 201: Orcish gear has no road in (issue #89)

materials.label: Nordic and Skaal
materials.lore: decision 0006: no Nordic element reaches the player

materials.label: Falmer
materials.lore: decision 0006: Skyrim's own peoples' gear

materials.label: Forsworn
materials.lore: decision 0006: Skyrim's own peoples' gear

materials.label: Skyrim's orders
materials.lore: decision 0006: the Dawnguard, the Blades, Penitus Oculatus, the Thieves Guild

never.why: Decision 0006: no Nordic element reaches the player through what we add; the gear of Skyrim's own peoples and orders (Nords, draugr, Stormcloaks, Falmer, Forsworn, Skaal stalhrim, the Dawnguard, the Blades, Penitus Oculatus, the hold guards) has no road into Black Marsh in 4E 201. Joined on our material: a Black Marsh piece whose record carries one of these keywords (an HTBM Kothringi helm, a KotM tribal robe) is filed by item_material under its true material and is not blocked.
